# Pulseq sequence file
# Created by PyPulseq
# PARAMETERS_JSON_START
# {
#   "rf_amp": {
#     "type": "float", "default": 90.0, "min": 0.0, "max": 360.0, "step": 1,
#     "unit": "deg", "pulseq_value": 625, "pulseq_unit": "Hz", "description": "flipangle"
#   },
#   "rf_dur":    { 
#	  "type": "int",   "default": 400, "min": 0,"max": 200000, "step": 10, 
#	  "unit": "us", "pulseq_value": 400, "pulseq_unit": "us", "description":"rf pulse duration"  
#	},
#   "rf_freq": {
#     "type": "int", "default": 0, "min": -20000, "max": 20000, "step": 10,
#     "unit": "Hz", "pulseq_value": 0, "pulseq_unit": "Hz", "description": "frequency offset relative to iso-center"
#   },
#   "rf_phase": {
#     "type": "float", "default": 0.0, "min": 0.0, "max": 360.0, "step": 1,
#     "unit": "deg", "pulseq_value": 0, "pulseq_unit": "rad", "description": "flipangle"
#   }
# }
# PARAMETERS_JSON_END

[VERSION]
major 1
minor 4
revision 2

[DEFINITIONS]
AdcRasterTime 1e-07 
BlockDurationRaster 1e-05 
GradientRasterTime 1e-05 
RadiofrequencyRasterTime 1e-06 

# Format of blocks:
# NUM DUR RF  GX  GY  GZ  ADC  EXT
[BLOCKS]
1  {int(rf_dur/10)}   1   0   0   0  0  0

# Format of RF events:
# id amplitude mag_id phase_id time_shape_id delay freq phase
# ..        Hz   ....     ....          ....    us   Hz   rad
[RF]
1      {rf_amp} 1 2 3 0 {rf_freq} {rf_phase}

# Sequence Shapes
[SHAPES]

shape_id 1
num_samples 2
1
1

shape_id 2
num_samples 2
0
0

shape_id 3
num_samples 2
0
{rf_dur}


[SIGNATURE]

# It can be reproduced/verified with md5sum if the file trimmed to the position right above [SIGNATURE]
# The new line character preceding [SIGNATURE] BELONGS to the signature (and needs to be stripped away for recalculating/verification)
